summary: Advance your career with our 5-day Convention Planning Training. Master APEX standards, ROI modeling, and ISO 20121 sustainability. Enroll today.
lede: Conference and convention planning helps event professionals organize large gatherings around clear objectives. Designed for professionals overseeing large events, the course covers budgeting, venue selection and contract negotiation alongside program design and on-site coordination. Participants practice planning event technology, assessing risks and using post-event data to report results to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the strategic and operational success of large-scale gatherings.
modules: Strategic Convention Foundation and APEX Standards
Sustainability and ESG in Convention Planning
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in event coordination or hospitality management. Familiarity with basic project management concepts and standard office productivity software is required. Prior experience with event registration systems is beneficial but not mandatory.
